introHtml: Brown plastic vinyl offers a warm, neutral base for your promotional products, ideal for brands with earthy tones or natural aesthetics. Whether you're outfitting a trade show team with custom lanyards or providing branded keychains for a corporate event, this color pairs well with foil stamping or screen printing. The vinyl material ensures durability and a professional finish that stands out without being flashy.
